name: Pollinations.ai
description: Open-source generative platform: free key, 130 vendor text models and 104 community models.
overview: Pollinations serves text, image and audio generation from gen.pollinations.ai behind a free secret key. The text catalogue has two tiers. Vendor models — OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, Z.ai, MiniMax and friends — are billed in Pollen, and free usage comes from Quest Pollen earned by solving GitHub quests, trying models or shipping an app; the dashboard spends Quest pollen before paid pollen. Community models are published by independent operators and appear in the same catalogue with a Free or Quest badge: a Free entry costs zero Pollen and is limited only by that operator's requests-per-minute cap, while a Quest entry bills the operator's per-token rates out of your earned balance. Both tiers are callable from the OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint, and a handful of vendor stealth models are also priced at zero.
free_access: Free secret key, no card required
Community models priced at zero Pollen — free to call, capped by their own RPM
Quest Pollen covers vendor models; earned via GitHub quests or trying models
About 1 request/15s on vendor models without extra credit
notes: Community models are third-party endpoints: several log prompts and their status flips between Alpha, Degraded and Down, so check the model card before sending anything sensitive. Quest pollen is earned, not replenished on a schedule, and it is spent before any paid pollen in the wallet.
